iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: US-Iran nuclear talks remain stalled via Pakistan mediation. IAEA chief Grossi warns any deal without agency involvement is 'illusion'. Iran introduced advanced 6th-generation centrifuges at Fordow (CSIS). ~200kg 60% HEU remains underground at Isfahan tunnel complex; lawmaker Nabavian confirmed uranium dispersed across country. No new 90% enrichment confirmed but Fordow capability expanding. Witkoff/Kushner en route to Islamabad Apr 25; Iran FM Araghchi rules out direct US talks. Probability 42%. Stable.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 80+. Trump extended ceasefire indefinitely Apr 21 at Pakistan's request. Iran FM Araghchi in Islamabad Apr 24-25 but Iran rules out direct US talks; observations conveyed via Pakistan. Witkoff and Kushner traveling to Islamabad Apr 25-26 for new mediation bid (AP, Reuters, CNN, WaPo). Iran seized 2 ships in Hormuz Apr 22-23; US seized Iranian-flagged Touska Apr 19 and boarded another tanker in Indian Ocean. Trump ordered military to 'shoot and kill' Iranian small boats laying mines (PBS Apr 23). Iran vows not to reopen Hormuz while US blockades its ports. UK-France hosted 30+ nation military planning conference at Northwood Apr 22-23 for post-conflict navigation security. Pentagon says clearing Hormuz mines will take months. Brent crude ~$103/b. Probability 60%. Stable.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Trump announced 3-week extension of Israel-Hezbollah truce on Apr 24 after hosting envoys at White House. US hosts second round of Lebanese-Israeli talks in Washington. However, Hezbollah MP says ceasefire 'meaningless' amid continued Israeli attacks. Israel struck Hezbollah sites in southern Lebanon after rocket fire Apr 24, killing 6 fighters in Bint Jbeil. Israel killed journalist Amal Khalil in southern Lebanon Apr 23 despite truce. 2,491+ killed in Lebanon since conflict began. Probability 20%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: Erdogan's Apr 12 threat against Israel debunked by Turkish sources as out-of-context 2024 quote. However, Nordic Monitor reports Turkey quietly preparing for war-like scenario with sweeping mobilization law changes expanding civilian infrastructure under military control. Israel signals Turkey as emerging concern (Military.com Apr 19). Tensions deepen amid Erdogan's confrontational policy (FDD Apr 20). Hosting NATO Summit Ankara Jul 7-8. Probability 10%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: No new direct military incidents. CFR report warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 due to heightened terrorist activity and Kashmir tensions (Apr 22). Defence Minister Rajnath Singh warns unprecedented action if Pakistan misadventures (Apr 2). Operation Sindoor anniversary context. Hormuz closure threatens India energy imports. Pahalgam attack one-year anniversary marked Apr 21. Probability 11%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: NATO scrambled six nations against Russian Tu-22M3 nuclear-capable bombers over Baltic Sea Apr 20-21 (AP, WaPo). Transponders off, no flight plan. Sweden's Chief of Defence Claesson warns Russia plotting to seize Baltic island as direct NATO challenge. Russia warned European states Apr 23 that hosting French nuclear-capable bombers would make them targets (Reuters, Grushko). Finland to receive first of 64 nuclear-capable F-35A jets in 2026; Russian envoy warns countermeasures (TASS Apr 19). Denmark intel assesses Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Moscow accuses Finland/Baltics of allowing Ukrainian drone overflights to strike Russian oil ports. Probability 55%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: Balikatan 2026 underway Apr 20-May 8 with 17,000 troops from US, Philippines, Australia, Japan, NZ, France, Canada. Japan's first large-scale participation. Coastal defence drills set for Batanes island chain <200km from Taiwan. China staged naval drills east of Luzon with Liaoning carrier among 14 vessels (SCMP Apr 24). China warns participants they are 'playing with fire' (ABC News). PLA holds joint drills in East China Sea after Japanese MSDF Taiwan Strait transit. Beijing fully supports Pakistan mediation on Iran. Xi met Taiwan opposition leader. Probability 55%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Launched multiple ballistic missiles from Sinpo Apr 19 -- 7th test of 2026, 4th in April. Kim expressed 'great satisfaction' over Hwasong-11 variant accuracy with cluster/fragmentation warheads (Reuters, Japan Times). Also tested cruise/anti-ship missiles from destroyer Choe Hyon (USNI Apr 15). IAEA confirmed rapid increase in activities at nuclear facilities. South Korean intel reports engine tests for new ICBM with multiple warheads. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Tokyo strongly protested launches. Probability 38%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1180+. Easter truce expired Apr 12 amid thousands of violations. EU formally approved 90 billion euro loan and 20th sanctions package Apr 23 (Council adopted). Hungary lifted veto after Ukraine restored Druzhba oil pipeline. Ukraine launched massive drone wave (700+ in single day) crippling Russian energy infrastructure; 40% of Russian oil export capacity disabled per satellite imagery. Russia refuses truce extension unless Kyiv accepts terms. Lavrov: patience not unlimited. Moscow published addresses of European companies aiding Ukrainian drone production as threat. Probability 35%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: China-mediated Urumqi talks ongoing since Apr 1. Both agreed not to escalate but fighting continues at lower intensity. Pakistan mortars killed Afghan civilians during talks. Pakistan Army Chief also mediating US-Iran talks. Afghanistan brands talks 'useful' (Al Jazeera Apr 7). Probability 5%. Stable.
